name: Claude Code
what: Anthropic's agentic coding tool. It reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, works with git and connects to MCP servers. It runs in the terminal, with VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a desktop app and a web version too.
who: Developers and vibe coders who want an agent that works across their whole project. Requires a Claude Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise or Console account (or a supported cloud provider).

setup.text: Homebrew and npm (needs Node 22+) also work:
setup.code:
brew install --cask claude-code
# or
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

setup.text: cd into your project and run:
Log in with your Claude account on first run. Add a CLAUDE.md file to give it project instructions.

prompts: Explain how this project is structured and where the auth logic lives.
Write tests for the auth module, run them, and fix any failures.
Commit my changes with a descriptive message.
